verdict.rationale: Device pairing is a fair question for an AI assistant platform with desktop and mobile apps, so the axis applies. However, the evidence never shows the assistant using paired phones or computers for screenshots, camera, notifications, or media playback. The mobile app is only described as a way to reach your agents on the go, and local-network MCP connectors are an adjacent building block, not device control.

support.subject: As a power user, the assistant reaches beyond one machine — paired phones and computers it can use for screenshots, camera, notifications, or media playback
